def solve(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for c in cnt:
        if c==bg: continue
        cells=[(r,i) for r in range(h) for i in range(w) if gi[r][i]==c]
        alliso=all(not(any((r+dr,i+dc) in cells for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))) for r,i in cells))
        if alliso and (best is None or cnt[c]<cnt[best]):
            best=c
    g=[row[:] for row in gi]
    for r in range(h):
        for i in range(w):
            if g[r][i]==best: g[r][i]=bg
    keep=[i for i in range(w) if any(g[r][i]!=bg for r in range(h))]
    return [[g[r][j] for j in keep] for r in range(h)]
ok=True
for n in range(1,9):
    m=solve(G[(n,'input')])==G[(n,'output')]
    ok&=m; print(n,m)
print(ok)

from collections import Counter
def solve(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cols=sorted(set(x for r in gi for x in r)-{bg})
    # noise: color whose cells never touch an equal cell orthogonally
    noise=[c for c in cols if not any(gi[y][x]==c and abs(y-y1)+abs(x-x1)==1 
                                       for y,x in [(a,b) for a in range(h) for b in range(w) if gi[a][b]==c]
                                       for y1,x1 in [(y+dr,x+dc) for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) 
                                       if 0<=y1<h and 0<=x1<w])]
    go=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if gi[y][x]!=bg:
                v=gi[y][x]; go[y][x]= v if v!=noise or len(noise)!=1 else bg
    # drop columns that are now all bg? check which demo drops cols
    return go
for k in sorted(G):
    if 'out' in k: continue
    outk=k.replace('in','out')
    g=G[k]; exp=G[outk]
    got=solve(g)
    print(k,'match',got==exp)

from collections import Counter
def solve(gi):

    for c in cols:

    n=noise[0]

        for x in range(w):

                col=g[y][x]; st=[(y,x)]; lab[y][x]=len(nids)
                cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))

from collections import Counter
def cleanup(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # delete singleton components (keep only cells with >=1 same-color orth neighbor)
    stay=set()
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            v=gi[y][x]
            if v==bg: continue
            neigh=sum(1 for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=y+dy<H and 0<=x+dx<W and gi[y+dy][x+dx]==v)
            if neigh>=1: stay.add((y,x))
    return [[7 if (y,x) not in stay else gi[y][x] for x in range(W)] for y in range(H)]

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def complete_rects(g,bg):
    g=np.array(g); out=g.copy()
    lab,n=ndimage.label(np.array(g)!=bg)
    for v in range(1,n+1):
        pts=set(zip(*np.where(lab==v)))
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        inn=[(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)]
        present=[(r,c) in pts for r,c in inn]
        if not any(present):  # hollow ring -> fill interior with ring color
            for r,c in inn:
                out[r][c]=g[r][c]
    return out.tolist()
for n in range(1,9):
    ki=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; ko=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    bg=Counter(x for r in ki for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    print(n, 'match' if complete_rects(ki,bg)==ko else 'no')

        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        key=(r0,r1,c0,c1,v,g[r0][c0] if pts else bg)

def comps(g,bg):

        res.append((int(g[pts[0]]),sorted(map(tuple,pts))))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter, deque
def comps_of(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; res=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                c=g[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; comp=set()
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); comp.add((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and g[ny][nx]==c and (ny,nx) not in comp:
                            comp.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
                ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
                a,b,e,d=min(ys),min(xs),max(ys),max(xs)
                res.append((c,a,b,e,d,len(comp)==(e-a+1)*(d-b+1),comp))
    return res

    return o

def comps_of(g,bg):

            if g[i,j]==bg or seen[i,j]: continue
            st=[(i,j)]; seen[i,j]=1; pts=[]
            while st:

                for dy in(-1,0,1):
                    for dx in(-1,0,1):

                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny,nx]==g[i,j] and not seen[ny,nx]:
